summary: Modal's Starter plan costs $0/month plus metered compute and includes $30/month in free credits, with up to 3 workspace seats, 100 containers, and 10 GPU concurrency. The credit recurs monthly as included compute rather than a one-time grant, and no expiry date or fixed end for the offer is stated on the pricing page. Claiming requires creating a Modal account via the Get Started flow. The docs billing guide corroborates that credits are deducted from monthly usage charges.
claim_steps: Go to https://modal.com/pricing and review the Starter plan ($0 + compute / month).
Click "Get Started" on the Starter plan to create a Modal account.
Create a workspace — the Starter plan includes up to 3 workspace seats.
Deploy functions; the Starter plan's $30/month in free credits counts against your compute usage, which is auto-charged only beyond the credit.

social_proof.title: Plan Pricing | Modal
social_proof.text: Starter | $0 + compute / month — "Get started with $30 / month free credit"; features list "$30 / month free credits, 3 workspace seats included".

social_proof.title: Billing | Modal Docs
social_proof.text: At the end of each billing cycle, you are auto-charged for the Modal usage incurred during that cycle (less any credits and incremental usage charges).
